objective: Implement and verify QIF v0.6.31 Calibration Report Records

assignment.assignment_reason: The Builder implements the portable package while Visionary and Guardian evidence constrain value and safety boundaries.

capability_fit.rationale: Existing package, verifier, fixture, and CLI patterns support a narrow composable implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Every statistic reproduces from declared decision-outcome pairs and policy.
Non-empirical or insufficient reports cannot claim calibrated status.
No report field or verifier result is treated as a quality verdict.

blocker_semantics.trigger_condition: a score, report, or sample count is represented as quality truth
blocker_semantics.recovery_action: restore explicit evidence and semantic review boundaries

hri_projection.speech_bubble: I will make every number traceable without turning it into a verdict.
hri_projection.next_action: Submit implementation and test evidence to Council review
